integrity: An unrestricted analytic proof is supplied; numerical verification is corroborative only. No independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only consecutive four-character spectra and characters of order at least seven or infinite order. Orders four through six are shown to violate the stable constant but their individual optima are not calculated. Equivalence to an older four-tap correlation-energy extremum is a residual bibliographic possibility.
title: A universal four-mode fourth-moment constant and the sharp seven-point sampling threshold
